claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Ethamivan is a small phenolic respiratory stimulant with no annotated cytotoxic target; at 2.5 uM for 5 days it is expected to be largely inactive, with any weak antiproliferative effect reflecting nonspecific phenolic/antioxidant chemistry rather than a defined killing mechanism.
